messages: Builds storytelling skills: every element of great writing, illustrated and explained.
Proven resources used in schools across the UK and US
Featuring stunning illustrations by Craig Kellman, the artist behind Madagascar and Minions

description.html:
Turn word-lovers into storytellers, one card and one chapter at a time. This bundle pairs a hilariously competitive vocabulary game with a step-by-step guide to writing a great story — everything a young writer needs to go from idea to finished tale.

Storyteller's Card Game gets the creativity flowing first: 300 illustrated word cards and 200 story prompts that build vocabulary while kids battle it out to tell the best story on the spot. Gather three or more players and let the competitive storytelling begin.

How to Write a Story then gives that creativity structure. This illustrated handbook walks kids through 21 story kits — building a character, creating real tension, and landing the ending — so every idea sparked at the card table can become a finished, well-crafted story.

Together, they cover both halves of great storytelling: the words to spark an idea, and the craft to see it through. Ideal for ages 7–12, whether it's game night, a rainy afternoon, or practice for a school writing assignment.

What's included:

  • Storyteller's Card Game (ages 7–11)
  • How to Write a Story (illustrated book, ages 8–12)
